status: Post-review refinements verified locally and prepared for GitHub publication. Check GitHub Actions for website deployment status; the Cloudflare Worker requires a separate deployment. The earlier published baseline checks are retained below.

postReviewRefinements.camera: Mouse wheel, touch drag and keyboard explore cropped scenery without changing Yuki's world position. Optional left/right edge buttons remain; no toolbar or Follow button. Selecting a garden destination resumes following. Cover scale and artwork ratio unchanged, with no blank edges or extra page scroll.
postReviewRefinements.water: Thirty independently phased glints span the masked pond, foreground stream/fall, three lake depths, two fine island falls and the existing three main waterfalls. Coordinate-seeded 4.8-9.1-second cycles avoid lockstep timing between groups. Distant glints are smaller and lower-opacity. Lake strokes now share water-only clip windows instead of unmasked strokes over islands. All effects retain pause and reduced-motion behavior.
postReviewRefinements.header: The unchanged shared portfolio header retains 88% themed opacity and 14px backdrop blur. The garden body supplies scenery beneath it so its glass tint is visible; navigation layout, labels and light/dark theme are not overridden.
postReviewRefinements.guiding: Fixed the missing prepareCall import that threw a ReferenceError and halted animation during guiding. Excluded only the decorative garden backdrop from content obstacles. Added EN/JA garden, home, nest and Petal Nook route aliases; explicit homepage requests still go to the portfolio. Garden arrivals point to the visible lookout, with cropped landmarks brought into view. Added backend garden-destination instructions; not deployed or live-model-tested.
postReviewRefinements.flight: Forward-facing vertical flights keep one direction family, and the flight projection clock now begins at the motion graph's actual frame/elapsed phase. Landing gating no longer starts one wing slot out of phase. Character frame artwork unchanged.
postReviewRefinements.checks: 347 tests passing; Jekyll build, source-mapped implementation notes and public knowledge checks pass. Browser checks: wide desktop wheel reaches both image bounds while preserving normalized Yuki position; EN Resume-to-garden request points to the actual Yuki tab and continues to the garden lookout with arrival follow-up; no console errors in that flow. EN/JA 390x844 views retain 390px document width and side-pan controls. Shared header opacity/blur and independent sparkle durations verified in rendered DOM. Representative checks only, not every interaction timing.

visualDirection: A bright fantasy interpretation of Petal Nook: outdoor castle garden, cherry blossoms, floating islands, leaf nest, pond, reading nook and keepsakes.

gardenLife.pond: SVG water surface traced in the original 1536 x 1024 illustration. Nested shoreline/lily exclusions prevent rings and highlights from drawing over banks or flowers, including overlapping lily masks. Pointer brushing, taps and keyboard input create bounded, expiring ripples. Each ring completes its 3.3-second lifetime; new emissions never evict existing rings. The safety capacity is 96 instead of 24, with whole new splashes skipped only under extreme saturation. Waterfall threads, gentle reflected light, sparse sun glints and drifting petals animate independently of Yuki.
gardenLife.discoveries: Eleven illustration-space targets: lantern, books, crane, pebble, nest, sky, castle, both blossom trees, flower bed and distant waterfall. Lantern toggles its glow; books and keepsakes cycle paired EN/JA authored lines; trees release petals, flowers attract butterflies, and nest interaction requests the existing sleep perch. Sky/castle wishes and waterfall mist use decorative, bounded particles. No new AI calls or character drawings.
gardenLife.ambient: Soft moving sunlight and cloud wisps, lake highlights, three traced distant waterfalls, and three wandering butterflies. The island flow runs from illustration y191 to y289, fading before the lake rather than spilling to y350. Castle-left water has separate visible sections above and below the balustrade; castle-right water is clipped behind flowers. Waterfall glints stay inside those masks, and six small pond glints use staggered, mostly invisible cycles. Send a Garden Breeze stirs both trees and the flowers. Optional Find Garden Surprises outlines interactive areas without adding permanent labels to the artwork.
gardenLife.accessibilityAndPerformance: Keyboard buttons, localized labels, live-status feedback, reduced-motion support, pause/hidden-tab handling, 96-ring and 90-particle limits, and cropped-away discovery controls removed from tab order. overflow:clip prevents native focus/scrollIntoView from shifting the garden or its menu behind the camera's back.
gardenLife.limits: This remains an illustrated 2D garden with aligned animated overlays, not fully deforming 3D scenery. Discoveries use authored rotating dialogue rather than model-generated replies. Landmark alignment is checked visually, not automatically detected.

deferredIdeas: Flying dragons crossing the sky and receding into the distance or leaving the view; requested for a later pass, not implemented.
interactions: Wake and fly to chosen spots
Float and daydream with approved airborne expressions, then land

Full-viewport garden below the unchanged shared portfolio header

locationAndTravel.persistence: One canonical page, position and pose in same-browser-tab sessionStorage. Regular navigation does not reset to the nest. Real Unix timestamps are validated with Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. English and Japanese paths share the record.
locationAndTravel.calling: Origin position determines departure time, with waking and takeoff before flight. Both legs and start time are saved so navigation can resume travel. Returning to her origin during departure allows a click/tap to cancel the journey. Airborne interception becomes a stationary hover using approved art.
locationAndTravel.entrance: A gold/violet filigree seal and starlike sparks stay at the header link corresponding to the origin section, including specific projects and essays. On an outgoing return/departure, it stays hidden during the approach and appears only after the character and hit target are hidden. The separate afterglow remains at the exit for 2.4 seconds. No dragon silhouettes, attached particles, sprite resizing or artwork edits. Reduced motion suppresses the effect.
locationAndTravel.inactivity: Existing 90-second inactivity sleep, then 45 seconds asleep before returning to the garden. Unloaded pages resolve overdue state logically without claiming background animation rendered.
locationAndTravel.limits: Separate browser tabs/devices do not share one globally synchronized dragon. Representative navigation and interruption paths tested; not every slow-device, tab suspension or resize timing is covered.

makingOf.presentation: Eight bilingual backend-only process topics and 19 explanations of actual implementation blocks, including location memory and timed, interruptible flight. No public making-of panels, raw-code browser or footer below the garden.
makingOf.userCorrection: Removed the experimental full-code browser, source-index download, generated code pages and copied historical archive. Original project and study source files remain untouched; ordinary client-side website assets are still required for the website to function.
makingOf.voice: Grounded in supplied source-verified notes; warm, casual and varied. Explains a block's inputs, operation, output and contribution without claiming live file access or inventing Lloyd's personal rationale. Missing details are acknowledged.
makingOf.coverage: Artwork preparation, lossless packaging, movement, breathing/blinking/lifecycle, navigation, AI retrieval, memory/translation, garden assembly and testing. Curated coverage, not every source line or historical revision.
makingOf.verification: An allowlisted build script locates exact source blocks and records line ranges and SHA-256 fingerprints. Checks fail if those blocks change until the descriptions are reviewed and refreshed. Generated backend metadata contains no copied raw source body.

ai.readingBeats: Optional 2–4 model-authored sentence-indexed emotion/gesture changes; existing full clips only, no synthesized audio or lip-sync. Invalid beat metadata falls back to the existing reply sequence.
ai.memory: Six allowlisted explicitly stated topic interests, same-tab storage with a 24-hour lifetime. Questions, hypotheticals and obvious sensitive messages excluded. Corrections take priority. Clear chat preserves interests.
ai.grounding: Public home-page context and five garden places remain available. Relevant implementation questions retrieve backend-only makingOf notes from any page, including a named block or a contextual follow-up. Garden lore is available from any page; current location only uses validated garden-spot context. Fiction and development facts are kept separate.
ai.costAndSecurity: Provider, output limit, quota enforcement, verification, optional search consent and paid-fallback policy unchanged. No new inference call required for expressions or interest extraction.
ai.liveQuality: Not verified for this change; requires backend deployment and live allowance. Local preview does not bypass the production-origin restriction.
